profile.headline: R&D Software Engineer at Broadcom
profile.summary: An experienced system software engineer with 15+ years experience in device driver and embedded firmware development.

positions.title: Senior Principal Engineer
positions.description:
(Cavium Acquired by Marvell)
Responsible for development and maintenance of VMware ESX and Linux device drivers for FC and FCoE adapters.  Worked with top OEMs, including HPe, Dell and Lenovo, in development, implementation and triaging of device driver issues and features.  Collaborated across functional teams to help deliver quality software on time to customers.

Designed and developed key technology and features in ESX driver - FC-NVMe, EDIF (Encrypted Data In-Flight), SAN Congestion Management, CPU affinity, T10 DIF, Secure Flash Update, VMID
positions.insights: Skills: VMware ESX · Device Drivers · Software Development · Linux Kernel · C (Programming Language) · NVMe · SCSI

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for development and maintenance of VMware ESX and Linux device drivers for FC and FCoE adapters.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Lead and mentored a team of 3 developers working across multiple geographic locations.
Ensured device driver features and releases were completed in a timely manner.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: VMware ESX · Device Drivers · Software Development · Kernel Drivers

positions.title: Staff Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented and verified SCSI T10 DIF support for FC 8G HBA product line.
• Developed Fibre Channel firmware for HBA products that met marketing requirements for low cost SMB solution boards.

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description: * Responsible for firmware development and testing for iSR6142 multi-protocol router and customer specific applications.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
* Devised test scenarios for failure analysis boards, which resulted in ASIC test vectors used to identify failing parts before chip tape out.
* Developed firmware utility for Intel 21554 non-transparent PCI bridge product

positions.title: Associate Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed POST firmware for 1G, 2G and 4G based FC adapters for customer use and support that was utilized to run on FC adapters in the field to uncover data integrity issues with on-chip memory.
•	Developed and implemented a comprehensive firmware regression test plan for FC adapters that identified firmware issues and improved product quality.

positions.title: Technical Student
positions.locationName: Pico Rivera, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Assisted in debugging custom embedded SPARC-based computing boards for avionics applications.
